name: modern-tome-viewer
description: Modern web viewer for Tales of Maj'Eyal (ToME4) talents, with advanced multi-level search and faceted filtering.

scripts.data: node scripts/build-data.mjs && npm run data:monsters && npm run data:items
scripts.data:supplement: node scripts/monsters/talent-supplement.mjs .. data/talent-supplement.json T_HEAT T_STAMINA_POOL T_MANA_POOL T_STEAM_POOL T_TUTORIAL_MIND_KB T_TUTORIAL_SPELL_KB T_TUTORIAL_MIND_FEAR T_TUTORIAL_SPELL_BLINK
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:monsters && npm run test:items && npm run test:scaling && npm run verify && npm run build:app && npm run smoke
